_notes: XP earned for a finished round, and what club upgrades cost. round_complete = base XP by number of holes. hole = XP for each hole's score. perfect_timing / perfect_power = per shot (a Perfect shot usually earns both; putts only have power). per_stroke_under_par = bonus for each stroke the round finishes under par. upgrade_cost[i] = XP to go from level i+1 to level i+2 (so the first number is level 1 -> 2). A quit round earns nothing. player_level_xp[i] = lifetime XP needed to reach player level i+1 (level 1 is 0 XP); past the end of the list each level costs player_level_step more.
